facts.fact: Dearness Allowance for Central Government employees is 60% of basic pay with effect from 01.01.2026
facts.quote: President is pleased to decide that the rates of Dearness Allowance payable to Central Government employees, shall be enhanced from 58% to 60% of the Basic Pay with effect from 1% January, 2026.
facts.note: DoE Office Memorandum No. 1/1(i)/2026-E.II(B) dated 22 Apr 2026 (scanned; quote from OCR, '1%' is OCR for '1st'). DoE's Dearness Allowance OM list (last updated 27 Oct 2026, https://doe.gov.in/en/orders-circulars/27) still has this OM as the latest, and PIB's Cabinet Decisions 2026 list shows no DA approval after 18 Apr 2026.

summary: DoE OM of 22 Apr 2026: DA raised from 58% to 60% w.e.f. 01.01.2026; no later DA instalment approved or notified as of 28 Oct 2026.
